## About the SRD

The **System Reference Document 5.2** is the updated reference for the 2024 revision of *Dungeons & Dragons 5th Edition*. It contains the core rules, classes, races, spells, monsters, feats, traits, and backgrounds that publishers may freely use under the CC BY 4.0 license.

- **Version**: 5.2
- **Source**: Wizards of the Coast LLC
- **License**: CC BY 4.0
- **Languages**: English (original), Spanish (SRD_CC_v5.2.1)

## Using this manual

This application indexes the SRD 5.2 content category by category. Every entry — class, race, spell, monster, feat, trait, or background — is stored with its English and Spanish versions so the application can render either language based on your UI selection.

When you copy an entry from this manual into one of your campaigns, the system keeps a reference back to the manual and stores a snapshot, so you can edit the entry without losing the link to its origin.

## Attribution template

If you publish material derived from the SRD 5.2, include attribution such as:

> This work includes material taken from the System Reference Document 5.2 ("SRD 5.2") by Wizards of the Coast LLC and licensed for your use under the Creative Commons Attribution 4.0 International License (CC BY 4.0).
